title: notification first load not post action
name: Notification first load not post action — Suomi.fi
rule: Notification is first-load page content, not a post-action pop-in — `role="region"`. Dynamic after interaction → InlineAlert. Dual-cite NSW in-page vs global alert.
pass_when: `Notification` is on the initial page load; post-action dynamic feedback uses InlineAlert.
fail_when: `Notification` is used as a post-interaction popup.
overview: Notification is first-load page content with role region; post-action feedback uses InlineAlert.
apply_when: Placing standing page notices versus feedback after a user action.
not_when: Post-interaction popups or toasts that announce a change the user just made.
agent_hint: Use Notification on initial load; switch post-action dynamic feedback to InlineAlert.
description: Suomi.fi Notification is first-load page content with `role="region"`, not a post-action pop-in after the user acts. Dynamic feedback after interaction belongs in InlineAlert instead (dual-cite NSW in-page vs global alert). Using Notification as a post-interaction popup misuses the component. Keep standing page notices in Notification; route action-triggered status to InlineAlert so the roles stay distinct.
do_not_claim: Toast row; NSW in-page vs global as a merge; ErrorSummary.
